notes:
Bring agents onto your boards.

- Connect an MCP client from Agents to read, create, edit and organize your boards.
- See each agent's named, colored cursor and the cards it is working on, including readable labels when agents share a target.
- Browse and edit freely while agents work on other boards. Agent edits support Undo and check for newer changes before saving.
- Find other-board activity in the sidebar and recent actions in the Agents panel.
- Agent access starts off. Enable it when needed, then turn it off to disconnect agents.

MCP connections require Node.js 20 or later. Open Agents → Enable agent access → Connect an MCP client for setup.
